report.explanation: All checkout observations returned 200 with sub-350ms durations; traces show successful order/inventory/payment/postgres/redis spans, logs are INFO with no errors, and metrics show zero 502s. The single 344ms sample is a minor outlier, not a sustained fault. No evidence supports any taxonomy cause (http-500, db-pool-exhaustion, redis-timeout, downstream-latency, memory-leak, bad-configuration). Memory retention is well under limit. Insufficient evidence to establish a bounded root cause; handing off.
